scope: Explain the enlarged yellow/blue-green microbial symbols and dotted nitrogen-conversion diagram directly above the live-rock model
hashMethod: SHA256 of sorted relative UTF-8 filenames followed by build bytes; CRLF normalized to LF in HTML/JS/CSS

findings: Visible color-and-text key identifies yellow as ammonia to nitrite and blue-green as nitrite to nitrate.
The caption explains that symbols are enlarged teaching aids, real microbes live in microscopic surface films, and the dotted path represents chemical-conversion order.
The irrelevant Water/Air/Waste legend is hidden for biology; its flow control is named Pathway on/off.
Reviewed desktop, 390px phone and 320px narrow-phone views; the key remains above the canvas without covering the model, including after explosion.
Existing geometry, motion, rock assets and all 42 selectable components are unchanged.

performanceNote: No new FPS benchmark for this HTML/CSS clarification. Full browser sweep confirms identical draw-call and triangle counts to the previous accepted build. Previous measured performance is retained in approved-skimmer-rock-build.json.
